ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/writeoff/v1/write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision (API-S7-002; the defer branch of the one committee-decision operation)
ops_consumed: The case read, rwb-case (P3), /api/recovery/case/v1, operation name placeholder
The case-move answers to rwb-case (P3), DEFERRED and SCAN_DUE, the stage outcome on the child-workflow boundary, operation name placeholder
The review-timer answer to rwb-case (P3), the timer row of DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036 created and cancelled, operation name placeholder
The WO rule package in force, rwb-decision (P7), /api/recovery/decision/v1, operation name placeholder
workflows: WriteOffWorkflow on queue rwb-writeoff in namespace rwb-recovery, the stage child of CaseWorkflow, carrying the deferral branch
recordCommitteeDeferral activity on queue rwb-writeoff, with R-WO-17, the refusal of R-WO-18 and the firing of R-WO-19
ReviewTimer, a durable workflow timer armed with the review date of R-WO-17 and fired once for R-WO-19
